heading: Vocabularies from Eight Aboriginal Dialects of the Island of Formosa, Collected by J. B. Steere, University of Michigan, during the winter of 1873-74. Six Lists of Words from the Aboriginal Languages of Formosa.
headings: Six Lists of Words from the Aboriginal Languages of Formosa
List of Words from Savages Living East of Onlau, near Foot of Mount Sylvia, Formosa.
List of Words from Savage Dialect of Pilam, on East Coast of Formosa.
Sentences from the Language of the Tsui-whan.
Sentences from the Language of the Lek-whan.
Sentences from the Language of the Che-whan, East of Posia.
Sentences from Pepo-whan Language of Bankimseng.

book.title: Formosa
book.author: J. B. Steere
book.imprint: Journal of the American Geographical Society of New York, 6, 1874, pp. 302-334 (vocabularies pp. 322-333)

provenance.collector: J. B. Steere; Rev. G. L. Mackay (Onlau); Rev. H. Ritchie (Pilam)

scan.rights: Public domain scan; image via Internet Archive

transcription: Transcribed from the scan; spellings kept as printed
about: J. B. Steere collected six word lists from the Tsui-whan, Lek-whan, Che-whan, Pepo-whan (from old women at Kongana and Bankimseng) and Kale-whan with the help of a Chinese interpreter in 1873-74, adding lists from Onlau and Pilam supplied by the missionaries Makay and Ritchie.
